concepts.picture: A huge brass compass dominates the lower two-thirds, its needle pointing down towards south. A smaller graded Earth globe and magnetic field lines behind it give planetary scale. This illustrates a reversal, not a claim that the present drift has already reversed the field.

concepts.picture: Single real NASA/ISS Expedition 62 aurora and airglow photograph (`ISS062-E-98264`, 16 March 2020, Nikon D5 50 mm) curving above Earth's night-lit limb for planetary scale. Textless LEARNINGS rule-19 real-frame test (0-3 words, no composite, no generative edits).
concepts.source_image: Official NASA Earth Observatory photograph `ISS062-E-98264` (`https://science.nasa.gov/earth/earth-observatory/aurora-meet-airglow-147122/`), credit: NASA / ISS Crew Earth Observations / Johnson Space Center. Built by `08_Thumbnail/build_j2143.py`; reviewed KEEP in J2166.

concepts.picture: A single enormous green-and-crimson aurora curtain over a recognisable London skyline (Westminster / Big Ben), with a tiny human silhouette at lower left for scale. Bright cyan twilight background with high contrast against the saturated curtain (LEARNINGS rule 14): a possible reversal-era sky, not a photograph of an observed event.
